purpose: Machine-readable registry for Cornell, USDA-ARS, GRIN and Breeding Insight bioinformatics/genetics resources that can support DTF Genetics and THC research systems without conflating public references with ingestible datasets.

rules: A public webpage is not automatically a redistributable dataset.
Do not ingest files, images, genotype matrices or marker payloads until the source-specific license or public-use terms are verified.
Keep hemp-population evidence separate from DTF drug-type cultivar observations.
Preserve source identity, accession identifiers, marker identifiers, genome/reference build, trait definitions, environment and study population with every derived record.
Do not promote source metadata or literature claims into DTF-observed phenotype/genotype truth.

next_ingestion_targets.target: Obtain a controlled GRIN Cannabis sativa accession/observation export and run it through scripts/normalize-grin-hemp-export.mjs.
Resolve public NCBI/GRIN sequence records produced by USDA project 445646 as they are released, binding every call to accession/sample/reference identifiers.
Resolve actual Hemp DArTag marker identifiers/coordinates from DArT/Breeding Insight or its public microhaplotype release; never infer coordinates.
Resolve supplementary/tabular accession-level disease data behind USDA/Cornell powdery mildew, Septoria and downy mildew publications.
Map USDA trait_name variables to exact Crop Ontology/Plant Ontology terms only where a confident semantic match exists.
